scenarios.title: Authorization PDF displays human-readable authorization URL
given: A user requests a scanner authorization PDF for a valid setup or event
scenarios.when: The user views the generated authorization PDF
then: The document displays a human-readable authorization URL alongside the QR code
The full authorization URL is plainly readable as text without truncation

scenarios.title: Human-readable URL matches the target encoded in the QR code
given: An authorization PDF has been generated with a QR code and a human-readable authorization URL
scenarios.when: The user compares the text of the human-readable URL with the destination encoded in the QR code
then: The human-readable URL directs to the identical authorization address encoded by the QR code

scenarios.title: User successfully authorizes device by navigating directly to the printed URL
given: A user has an authorization PDF containing a human-readable authorization URL
The user is using a laptop or browser without scanning the QR code
scenarios.when: The user navigates directly to the human-readable authorization URL in their web browser
then: The device is recognized as authorized for scanning
The user receives confirmation that the scanner setup is complete

scenarios.title: Navigating to an authorization URL from an expired authorization PDF shows an authorization error
given: An authorization PDF was generated for an event or session that has expired or been revoked
scenarios.when: The user navigates to the human-readable authorization URL shown on the PDF
then: An error message indicating the authorization link has expired or is invalid is displayed

scenarios.title: Requesting an authorization PDF with invalid event details fails
given: A user attempts to generate an authorization PDF with missing or non-existent event parameters (e.g. an unknown event code)
scenarios.when: The user submits the authorization PDF request
then: An error message indicating invalid event details is presented to the user
No authorization PDF with an active authorization URL is produced
